title: SvgFeDiffuseLighting
responsibility: Renders the native feDiffuseLighting element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeDiffuseLighting.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet rendered inside the native feDiffuseLighting element when its value is truthy. The component calls it with no arguments and skips rendering it when its value is falsy.

outputs.name: SvgFeDiffuseLighting
outputs.description: One native feDiffuseLighting SVG element receives every prop other than children through attribute spreading. A truthy children snippet renders inside it, with no wrapper element added.
